column3: Ayase Route ・ Carnage Arc
What is it, Onii-san? You look so serious.
Ah, well... Actually...
There's something about Kirino that I need to discuss with you.
! ...Tell me.
I told Ayase what Kirino had talked to me about.
And that's how it is.
Kirino had that on her mind...
Okay. I'll call her today and talk it out with her.
Yeah, please do.
While I was having fun with you, Onii-san... I ended up completely neglecting Kirino.
I felt awful when that happened to me, but now I've done the same to Kirino.
I'm such an idiot.
Ayase...
Um... You won't go saying something like "Kirino is more precious to me, so let's break up", right? Because I don't want that.
Pfft...
Ahaha, Onii-san, you're so useless.
Guh...
But I don't mind that side of you.
Why, thank you.
But I definitely won't break up. After all, I love you.
T-That so?
No, I shouldn't go getting excited here.
Instead, why don't we tell her the truth?
Eh?
To come clean and tell her about us.
Eeh?!
Well...
You sure about that?
I mean, Kirino likes Ayase a lot, right?
If we told her that we're dating, wouldn't she go mad with jealousy?
She will definitely object, but it's not like we can hide it forever.
True, but... Let's just not tell her for now.
Don't worry about it; I already know.
Guh?!
K-Kirino?!
Good morning, Ayase. Why do you look so surprised?
W-Why... are you here? And how did you know?
You were on a date at Summer Comiket, weren't you?
H-How do you know that?
How? Unlike you, a certain nice and good friend of mine told me everything.
A good friend...?
It couldn't be...
Yeah, it's me. Uh-huh, uh-huh, yeah, I caught them, thanks.
Eh? What? You want to talk to him? Alright, I'm handing it to him.
Here, call for you.
For me? Hello, it's me.
Long time no see.
Kuro...neko...
So you told Kirino about it.
Wrong... Heh. I told you, didn't I?
Right now, I'm the angel of vengeance, Yamineko.
Wha-- That's...!
She's still on the dark side, huh? What "angel of vengeance"? She's just pure evil!
Look, you've gone and made a mess of this!
Congratulations.
Why would you do this?!
Figure it out yourself.
Now look here...
Maybe I didn't tell you before...
But I like you.
Huh?!
Probably about as much as your sister does.
In that sense, your sister is another me.
Get that into your head already. If you still can.
She hung up.
Done? Then give it back.
Alright, time to talk to me.
Kirino.
I can't put this off any longer.
This really is the last 【two-shot conversation】.
...Am I prepared for this?
Maybe I should save before this?
Leave it to me! I'm going to make it!
I'm going to make Kirino accept my relationship with Ayase!
